authority_policy: Current official event deadlines and API scoring override explanatory articles; narrative edge cases are versioned overlays. Preserve conflicts.
fpl_access_scope: User-stated verified grant for required FPL scraping; other services have separate adapters.

sources.fields: all registered players, clubs, events, prices, scoring, chip periods
sources.units: integer GBP 0.1m; minutes; probabilities 0..1 after normalization

sources.fallback: last immutable snapshot; null-event fixtures remain unassigned

sources.fields: fixture-level official scoring, xG/xA, starts/minutes, defensive actions
sources.fallback: position priors, wider uncertainty and explicit missingness
dated structured import; never infer private future squad

sources.fields: partial public leaderboards; topProjected is not a full-market multiweek forecast
sources.fallback: independent component forecasts; missing comparator values stay missing

sources.provenance: Retrospective statistical archive; not proof of pre-deadline news/price availability

sources.fields: supporting source text and exact evidence spans
sources.fallback: manual supported evidence and dated official availability flags

sources.url: Gemini or Groq configured provider endpoints
sources.free: account-specific verification required; disabled by default
sources.fallback: structured human evidence; numerical engine remains operational

sources.provenance: Capture and containing commit precede target deadline; compressed hash pinned
sources.fallback: Missing context excluded from historical fusion dataset

sources.fields: Prior-season qualification; independently verified FPL history and released picks
sources.provenance: No current-season rank selection; lag one decision deadline
Retrospective match facts; reject conflicting dates; explicit zero minutes only

sources.fields: Public specialist articles and source-supported claims
sources.fallback: Queue extraction; no speculative numerical uplift
Disclose HTTP failure; no access bypass

sources.fields: Current top 1,000 public entry histories, released squads and transfers
sources.analysis_use: Calibrated transfer-count mixture and feasible rival branches; separate from prior-qualified expert features
sources.provenance: Current-rank cohort is retrospective; only earlier released decisions enter each test feature
sources.fallback: Frequency prior; explicit hold/greedy sensitivity scenarios

sources.fields: Paired 40–72-hour pre-deadline prices, flows, ownership and status; price/news labels strictly after input capture
sources.provenance: Both captures and containing Git commits precede target deadline; hashes pinned
sources.fallback: Training-only class frequencies; timing outside support explicitly sensitivity

sources.fields: Rank-stratified actual entries, released picks, histories and transfers
sources.provenance: Current standings frame, seven bands, participation/activity calibration; not prior-qualified elites
sources.fallback: No extrapolation if any complete rank stratum missing; explicit model uncertainty
